name: GREval-Bench
description: GREval-Bench is a collection of GRE-style questions used to evaluate language models on verbal reasoning and quantitative problem solving similar to the Graduate Record Exam. It measures models' ability to answer multiple-choice items across vocabulary, reading comprehension, and quantitative reasoning. The benchmark is provided as a dataset on Hugging Face for standardized evaluation of model performance on graduate‑level exam tasks.
reputation: A community-hosted Hugging Face dataset for GRE-style evaluation with limited but increasing usage among researchers benchmarking reasoning abilities of LLMs.
